Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class OttConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.OttConfiguration
@Configuration(value="ottWebConfiguration", proxyBeanMethods=false) public class OttConfiguration extends Object
Wires the one-time token methods into the login/UI chain. The filters are built here and handed to the customizer, never declared as beans: Spring Boot would register every Filter bean in the servlet container, outside the security chain. The providers are held in OttProviders, not declared as AuthenticationProvider beans, for the reason given there. The bean is named apart from the application layer's configuration of the same name.
